models.label: typescript Intended Model
models.description: Oreko is a Turborepo monorepo. The shared packages (types, utils, database, ui) are the foundation and do not depend on each other or on the web app. Inside apps/web, routes sit on top of components, components sit on top of lib (server actions and domain logic), and lib sits on top of the shared packages.

groups.label: packages-types
groups.description: Shared TypeScript types and enums used across the monorepo. Has no internal dependencies.

groups.label: packages-utils
groups.description: Framework-agnostic helper functions shared across the monorepo. Has no internal dependencies.

groups.label: packages-database
groups.description: Prisma schema and client. The only place that talks to PostgreSQL directly.

groups.label: packages-ui
groups.description: Shared UI primitives reusable outside the web app.

groups.label: web-app
groups.description: Next.js App Router pages, layouts and API routes: auth, dashboard, public client portal and webhooks. Composes components and calls lib.

groups.label: web-components
groups.description: React components by feature (quotes, invoices, clients, payments, ...) plus Shadcn UI. Presentation only; mutations go through lib actions.

groups.label: web-lib
groups.description: Server actions, domain logic, validations, auth, email, PDF, payments and integrations. Reaches the database through packages-database.
